spec.body_markdown: ## Designing a Good Experiment\n\nA solid experiment starts with one sharp, testable question - not a vague one. From there you decide exactly what you'll measure, change only ONE variable at a time, keep every other variable fixed, and run at least 3 trials per condition. Planning for likely sources of error before you start saves you from throwing out data later.
